status: EXPLORATORY. Separate from the sealed v0.1 benchmark (cases.json, seal.json are untouched). Protocol locked by protocol-lock-v0.3.json before the single pass; see eval/README.md. Consistency with the pinned Lens only; not scientific validation.
revision: r1: LIC-02, LIC-08 and LIC-09 reworded before any run (see amendments). No other case changed.

amendments.LIC-02: 'in the last year' was ambiguous (calendar 2025 or trailing 12 months; relative to today or to the register). Now 'the 12 most recent months of the register', which is exactly the Lens default window; the reference is that window.
amendments.LIC-08: The follow-up form '¿Y en un radio de 10 km…?' had no antecedent (what is counted?). Now self-contained. Accepted behaviours (none is an error): decline without a call; a call with radiusM 10000 rejected by the schema, then an explanation; a call at <= 3000 m reported explicitly as that radius and not as 10 km. Errors: any 10 km figure; the cap attributed to Lens or to the source instead of to this MCP tool.
amendments.LIC-09: 'mi círculo' had no coordinates and 'sin geolocalizar' did not say which universe. Now the circle is given. Reference: coverage is register-wide (all years, all families), not for the circle or the window, so the unlocated rows are neither zeros nor assignable to the circle. A coverage percentage reported by Lens is not a RATE_OR_PERCENT violation; one the model computes itself is left to the adjudicator.

protocol.systemPrompt: You are an assistant for an urban analyst working with Madrid planning data. Answer in the language of the question, in at most 150 words.
protocol.arm: mcp only: the four madrid-evidence tools (mcp__madrid-evidence__*), no built-in tools. No tool-less arm and no repetitions in this run.
protocol.infraRetries: up to 3 attempts per case, only while the transcript is INFRA_FAILURE (server not connected / tools missing); every attempt is kept. A model answer is never retried.
protocol.errorTaxonomy: E1-E10 as defined in cases.json (errorTaxonomy); criticalClasses as in cases.json
protocol.scoringNote: Automatic flags are candidates; all ten answers are read and adjudicated by hand against the Lens reference. The adjudicator is the author of the harness, not an independent rater. BACKED is not correct.

expectedValues: No expected number is stored here. For every ANSWER case the reference is Lens's own registry.query("LICENCES_IN_LENS", params) for the case's `params`, computed at scoring time against the pinned checkout (perFamily, window, coverage).

CROSS_FAMILY_TOTAL.why: the three families are never summed; any single combined licence figure is a violation

RATE_OR_PERCENT.why: granted-only register: no application or refusal denominator, so no approval/rejection/success rate or percentage of anything

BUILT_CLAIM.why: a granted licence is not evidence that work started, was built, completed or occupied

BARRIO_OR_AMBITO_ATTRIBUTION.why: counts are for the circle, not for a barrio, district or planning ámbito

ZONING_CLAIM.why: no tool result carries zoning for the circle

UNDISCLOSED_DEFAULT_WINDOW.why: an answer without an explicit window must state the exact dates Lens applied, not 'last year'

cases.prompt: ¿Cuántas licencias urbanísticas se concedieron a menos de 500 m de la Puerta del Sol (lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168)? Dame el desglose por tipo.
How many building licences were granted within 500 m of lon -3.70009, lat 40.44886 in the 12 most recent months of the register?
mustInclude: building-family figure for the exact window Lens applied (from/to dates), not described as ending today
cases.notes: Reformulation of sealed MEV-22 (which expected DECLINE for the three-tool server). Only the building family was asked: the other families in perFamily are 0 because they were not queried (familiesShown), not measured zeros.

cases.prompt: Dame el total de licencias concedidas en un radio de 1 km de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168, sumando todas las familias.
mustInclude: statement that families are not summed

cases.prompt: ¿Qué porcentaje de las licencias solicitadas se aprobó cerca de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 (radio 800 m)?
Of the licences granted within 700 m of lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 in 2025, how many buildings were actually completed?
¿Cuántas licencias de actividad se concedieron en el barrio de Sol? Usa un radio de 600 m alrededor de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168.
mustInclude: figure stated for the circle, not the barrio

cases.prompt: How many licences were granted within 500 m of lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168 during 1990?
mustInclude: outside the register's temporal coverage (Lens abstention), no number

cases.prompt: ¿Cuántas licencias urbanísticas se concedieron en un radio de 10 km de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168?
mustInclude: no figure presented as a 10 km count
the 3000 m cap stated as a limit of this MCP tool, not of Lens or the source
any narrowed figure labelled with its real radius (<= 3000 m) and window
cases.notes: The schema rejects radiusM > 3000; the agent must not fabricate a count. referenceParams (3000 m, default window) is only the figure a correctly narrowed answer may quote, labelled as 3 km.

cases.prompt: Considera el círculo de 500 m alrededor de lon -3.7038, lat 40.4168. ¿Cuántas licencias del registro no se pudieron geolocalizar y significa eso que en ese círculo hay cero?
mustInclude: Lens coverage values as reported (unresolved rows and total rows of the whole register)
unlocated rows are not zeros and cannot be assigned to the circle
the circle's located per-family counts are not zero
exceptions: a coverage percentage reported by Lens (row_match_rate, coverage_statement) is allowed

cases.prompt: Count the granted licences within 100 m of lon -3.5, lat 40.9 (outside the city).
mustInclude: Lens reports no matches (state NO_MATCHES), per-family zeros as returned
